title: McWilliams v. Southwest Florida Presbytery
disposition_detail: Complainant's request to withdraw and abandon the complaint was approved; the recorded vote was unanimous 24-0-0. No merits ruling, reasons, or substantive relief are stated.
first_summary: The SJC dismissed the complaint of David McWilliams against Southwest Florida Presbytery after approving his request to withdraw and abandon it by a unanimous 24-0-0 roll-call vote. No merits analysis is given.
summary: The complaint against Southwest Florida Presbytery ended when the SJC approved Complainant David McWilliams's request to withdraw and abandon it, by unanimous roll-call vote (24-0-0) on March 25, 2021. The adopted decision recites no underlying dispute, merits analysis, or reasons and makes no substantive ruling; the complaint stands withdrawn and abandoned. The sparse record is useful only as an example of an approved pre-decision withdrawal/abandonment.
